title.rendered: E-Scrap Processing with Tomra Autosort Fines Optical Sorter

content.rendered:
TOMRA Autosort processing e-scrap.

The TOMRA AUTOSORT Fines optical sorter, used in electronics recycling or e-scrap processing, accurately finds and sorts precious metal pieces in the 1-2 mm range. It acts as a “Swiss Army Knife” to produce a clean metals fraction, clean green circuit boards, upgrade your plastics fraction, and clean up your aluminum and other precious metals.

Click here to read more about TOMRA products.
